name: Italy
title: Holidays in Italy
intro: Ancient ruins, lakes, pasta and gelato. Here's where to go on holiday in Italy, how long to stay and the best time to visit.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Italy?
faqs.answer: Spring and early autumn are best for most of Italy: April and May, then September and October. Summer can be very hot and busy.

faqs.question: Where in Italy is good for a beach holiday?
faqs.answer: Puglia and Syracuse, in Sicily, have warm sea and good food, best in June and September.

faqs.question: Where in Italy is good away from the cities?
faqs.answer: Lake Garda has swimming, boats and walks, and Matera's old cave town is like nowhere else.
